capabilities: Publish notes to Google Blogger as draft or live
Add inline styles to Markdown tables before publishing
Embed local vault images as base64 data URIs
Render math to inline SVG or send it as TeX
Manage multiple Blogger profiles and auto-fit oversized posts
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; UI available in English and Korean; the plugin contacts only Google OAuth2 and Blogger API endpoints and sends no telemetry.
problem: Blogger themes barely style tables and cannot display local vault images, so notes published from Obsidian lose their tables, images and equations.

relations.evidence: Publish your Obsidian notes to Google Blogger
Math is rendered to inline SVG (or sent as TeX) using MathJax

requires.name: Google account with a blog on Blogger
Google Cloud OAuth2 client ID and secret

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to Google Blogger with inline-styled tables, base64-embedded vault images and MathJax-rendered math.
